lesson: The short position failed because it ignored the exhaustion phase of the markdown, attempting to trend-follow into an oversold liquidity trap. The system correctly identified the bearish structure but failed to account for the high probability of a mean-reversion bounce at extreme RSI levels.
adjustment: Require a confirmed bearish market structure break (MSB) on the 1h timeframe before entering shorts when the 4h RSI is below 30.
methodology_flag: Trust RSI oversold conditions more than trend-following momentum in deep markdown phases.
